Main.AutoSense.description: Turn Amp on when signal sensed

Main.DigitalOut.Rate.description: Set the digital out sample rate

Main.IR.Channel.description: Set the IR Channel for the front IR sensor

Main.Sources.description: Returns the total number of sources depending on what MDC cards are installed.

Source1.ADCSampleRate.description: This only applies to analog sources. For Phono inputs the value is fixed at 48.

Source1.AnalogGain.description: This only applies to analog sources and is similar to the "Balance.Leveltrim" and "Single_Ended.Leveltrim" variables of the C390. The valid values of this variable depend on the input type.

Source1.Enabled.description: This is actually multiple variables, one for each source. Example: Source5.Enable
